top_papers.title: Is GraphRAG Needed? From Basic RAG to Graph-/Agentic Solutions with Context Optimization
top_papers.abstract: As advanced RAG variants like GraphRAG and Agentic RAG emerge, one leading question is when and how to use them. Here, we introduce a framework for different RAG scenarios evaluation and comparison on semi-structured knowledge bases, including regular RAG, GraphRAG, Modular RAG and Agentic RAG.
